statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10)
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
A cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is indicated
The study is to evaluate for underlying rhythm disturbances
The patient's presenting symptom is dizziness and giddiness (R42)
The claim was denied under reason code CO-97
